query:
DEFINE
    VAR _CompanyFilter = TREATAS({ "emp", "titan" }, 'Company'[Name])

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'emp CreditLedger'[ApplicationName],
    'emp CreditLedger'[ModelName],
    _CompanyFilter,
    "Credits", [Total credits consumed],
    "Requests", [Requests completed till now]
)
ORDER BY 'emp CreditLedger'[ApplicationName], 'emp CreditLedger'[ModelName]
